replay-software-mainstream.dek: Northstar's Atlas release has put deterministic simulation in front of enterprise buyers who had never heard the term.
body: Northstar's release of Atlas 1.0 this week has done something unusual for a developer tool: it has made a technical idea, deterministic simulation, into a line item that corporate buyers are asking about.

The tools run software inside a simulated computer in which time, randomness and message order are all controlled, so a failure can be replayed exactly. The price is speed; simulated runs are several times slower than native ones.

Enterprise interest has been strongest in finance and infrastructure, where the cost of finding a bug often exceeds the cost of fixing it. Reuters reported the release at http://reuters.com/2026/northstar-atlas-determinism and The Verge has a longer feature at http://theverge.com/2026/atlas-determinism
Northstar has not disclosed its revenue.
